description:
A colleague left behind a Stroop experiment that is supposed to work but does not. The experiment file is at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/broken_stroop.psyexp and the conditions file is at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/conditions/stroop_conditions.csv.

The experiment was described as a standard color-word Stroop task: participants see color words displayed in different ink colors and must press a key corresponding to the ink color (left=red, down=green, right=blue). It should have an instructions screen before the trials.

However, the experiment has multiple problems that prevent it from running correctly. Your job is to identify every issue, fix them all, and save the corrected experiment as:
  /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/stroop_fixed.psyexp

The corrected experiment must be a fully functional Stroop task that references the existing conditions file, accepts proper keyboard responses, runs a reasonable number of trials, and presents instructions before the trial block.
